description: PRD-207 — Test Strategy Foundation. Stand up the test harness the whole REMEDIATION suite depends on: Vitest (unit) + testcontainers Postgres (integration) + rehabilitated Playwright (E2E). Today effective coverage is ZERO (one E2E spec that auto-skips). Phased, dependency-ordered: Phase 1 (US-001..006) = Vitest unit harness + security-critical unit suites (encryption, drgreen webhook, api-auth, sanitizeCss) + report-only coverage thresholds — node-only, NO Docker/Clerk, fully autonomous, and closes PRD-200 AC-3a (sanitizeCss tests). Phase 2 (US-007..010) = testcontainers Postgres 17 integration harness + typed factories + the PRD-202 tenant-isolation concurrency proof — REQUIRES a running Docker daemon; if `docker info` fails the agent marks the story BLOCKED-DOCKER and emits RALPH_BLOCKED. Phase 3 (US-011..015) = Playwright rehab (programmatic Clerk auth so the suite stops skipping) + four critical-path E2E specs (onboarding, storefront order, consultation/KYC, super-admin) — BLOCKED-NEEDS-AUTH-DECISION pending PRD-207 OQ-1 (Gerard owns the Clerk test-auth approach). App lives in nextjs_space/ (pnpm, Next 14.2.35, Prisma 6.7, Postgres 17, Clerk). Source PRD: docs/PRDS/REMEDIATION/PRD-207-test-strategy-foundation.md. Global rule: integration tests hit a REAL DB via testcontainers, never mocks; tests load .env.test only, NEVER the real .env/Railway secrets; 80% aggregate coverage, 95% on the security-critical module set.
